tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Lists the U.S. telehealth specialties this server covers, with each specialty’s slug, the treatment keys it accepts (for example semaglutide, tirzepatide, trt, sermorelin, nad) and how many programs it has. Use it when you need the exact category slug or treatment key before calling find_programs, o

tools.name: find_programs
tools.description: Finds online telehealth programs in one U.S. specialty and sorts them by lowest advertised monthly price. Use it when the user asks which online program is cheapest, which programs offer a treatment (e.g. compounded tirzepatide, TRT, sermorelin), which are LegitScript-certified, or which fit a budge

tools.name: get_program
tools.description: Returns the full sourced record for one program: every price and plan term, membership and lab fees, approval type, LegitScript status, caveats, source URLs and check date. Use it when the user asks about one specific provider (e.g. "Is Henry Meds legit?", "What does Hone Health charge for NAD+?") o

tools.description: Compares 2 to 5 programs from the same specialty side by side: monthly prices, membership, approval type, blood work, LegitScript status, extra fees, caveats and sources for each. findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_categories" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
